title: Concept: MySQL server or driver error text disclosed in a response
description: Database driver errors name the host, the engine version and sometimes the credential source. Echoing them to a client turns a failed query into a map of the deployment, and it gives an injection probe immediate feedback about whether the query even reached the database.
applicability: Responses generated by a PHP, Java or Node service backed by MySQL or MariaDB.
risk: The caller learns the database engine, its version and the internal hostname, which shortens the next step of an attack and confirms which injection syntax the backend will accept.
